name: CategoryTheory.induct_on_objects
script:
intro J inst hc p j₀ h0 h1 j
have key := CategoryTheory.constant_of_preserves_morphisms
    (fun k : J => (⟨k ∈ p⟩ : ULift.{u₁, 0} Prop))
    (fun j₁ j₂ f => by exact congrArg ULift.up (propext (h1 f))) j j₀
have h : (j ∈ p) = (j₀ ∈ p) := congrArg ULift.down key
rw [h]
exact h0

name: CategoryTheory.MonoOver.isIso_iff_isIso_left
script:
intro C inst X A B f
constructor
· intro h
  haveI := h
  have h2 : CategoryTheory.IsIso
      ((CategoryTheory.Over.forget X).map ((CategoryTheory.MonoOver.forget X).map f)) :=
    inferInstance
  exact h2
· intro h
  haveI h1 : CategoryTheory.IsIso ((CategoryTheory.Over.forget X).map f.hom) := h
  haveI h2 : CategoryTheory.IsIso f.hom :=
    CategoryTheory.isIso_of_reflects_iso f.hom (CategoryTheory.Over.forget X)
  haveI h3 : CategoryTheory.IsIso ((CategoryTheory.MonoOver.forget X).map f) := h2
  exact CategoryTheory.isIso_of_reflects_iso f (CategoryTheory.MonoOver.forget X)

name: Complex.comap_exp_nhds_zero
script:
have hnorm : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖Complex.exp z‖ = Real.exp z.re := fun z => by
  simp [Complex.norm_exp]
refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
· refine Filter.tendsto_iff_comap.1 (Filter.tendsto_atBot.2 fun b => ?_)
  have h1 : Complex.exp ⁻¹' Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (Real.exp b) ∈
      Filter.comap Complex.exp (nhds (0 : ℂ)) :=
    Filter.preimage_mem_comap (Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 (Real.exp_pos b))
  rw [Filter.eventually_iff]
  refine Filter.mem_of_superset h1 fun z hz => ?_
  have h2 : z.re < b := by
    simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, hnorm, Real.exp_lt_exp] using hz
  exact h2.le
· refine Filter.tendsto_iff_comap.1 ?_
  have h : Filter.Tendsto (Real.exp ∘ Complex.re)
      (Filter.comap Complex.re Filter.atBot) (nhds 0) :=
    Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp Filter.tendsto_comap
  refine tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero.2 ?_
  simpa [Function.comp_def, hnorm] using h
